view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse aisle with tall metal shelving units stocked with boxes. Pallets loaded with goods line the aisle, which extends into the distance. A forklift is visible in the background. The floor is concrete, and lighting fixtures hang from the ceiling.

objects.label: warehouse shelving
objects.observation: Tall black metal racks extend vertically and horizontally, holding stacked boxes. They dominate the left and center of the frame. Some shelves have yellow protective bumpers attached. The structure appears industrial and utilitarian.

objects.label: stacked white boxes
objects.observation: White boxes with yellow bands are stacked in multiple rows on wooden pallets along the aisle. They are positioned directly under the shelving and appear to be secured to the pallets. Boxes are aligned neatly in columns.

objects.label: red boxes
objects.observation: Bright red boxes with green circular logos are arranged on a wooden pallet in the foreground. They are stacked in a grid pattern and sit at the base of the shelving unit. Their vivid color contrasts with surrounding items.

objects.label: wooden pallets
objects.observation: Light-colored wooden pallets support stacks of boxes. One is in the immediate foreground, another runs along the aisle. They rest directly on the concrete floor and are used for storage and transport within the warehouse.

objects.label: yellow protective bumper
objects.observation: A vertical yellow plastic bumper is mounted on the black metal shelving frame near the foreground. It is positioned to prevent collisions between forklifts or carts and the rack. Its bright color makes it highly visible.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: A gray forklift is visible in the distant background, parked or moving slowly down the aisle. It is partially obscured by shelves and boxes. Its presence indicates active warehouse operations.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: The warehouse floor is smooth, light gray concrete that stretches across the entire image. It provides a clean, uncluttered surface for movement and storage. No markings or lines are visible.

You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s4-31857", "image_size": [1280, 800], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
